title: Gradual compatibility gateway & customer-readiness sprint plan for model API cutover
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Execute a predictable, low-friction cutover from api-v2 to api-v3 by introducing a Compatibility Gateway layer, clear migration guides, and a coordinated communications cadence. This ticket owns the cross-functional sprint plan for PM/Eng/Design/Support/GTM to ensure customers can migrate with minimal service disruption and predictable billing mapping. Primary constraints: maintain latency SLOs, preserve behavior for common prompt patterns, and avoid regressions in embeddings/structured-output endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility Gateway service deployed in staging and can route v2-style requests to v3 variants with feature-flagged transformation shims
Comprehensive migration guide published with code samples (Node/Python/cURL) and an automated migration CLI that updates client config across projects
Release notes and change log published and approved by Legal/Support/PR at least 72 hours before public announcement
Customer cohort pilot (10 customers) completes smoke testing and reports no functional regressions for top-3 flows
Rollback gating: automated traffic split and one-click rollback via Console with documented runbook
rollout_timeline: 2025-02-18: Dev sprint finishes gateway MVP and transformation shims (ENG), feature flag in place
2025-02-24: Internal dogfood + integration test week; capture latency/cost deltas
2025-03-03: Publish migration RFC and invite 3 CSMs to pilot cohort
2025-03-10: Start 4-week pilot with segmented customers (beta tier + 3 enterprise accounts)
2025-03-31: Collect pilot feedback, finalize CLI and docs
2025-04-07: Release notes freeze & GTM review complete
2025-04-14: Public announcement & staged cutover begins (10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h windows)
2025-04-15: Full cutover complete and api-v2 set to read-only deprecation mode
cross_team_tasks: Engineering: implement gateway transforms, metrics, traffic-splitting hooks, and one-click rollback APIs
Design: update Console gtm pages for migration workflow and a migration progress dashboard
Docs: author migration guide, FAQ, API compatibility matrix, and sample code snippets
Support/CS: create support playbook, triage checklist, and train first-line agents (session + mock tickets)
GTM/PR: draft announcement, customer comms cadence, and blog post; schedule webinars and office hours
Legal/Revenue: validate contract language and billing mapping for deprecated endpoints
Security/Compliance: confirm compatibility gateway does not introduce new audit vectors; sign-off on logs retention
release_notes_outline: Summary: What changes in api-v3 that affect behavior and performance
Compatibility Gateway: how we maintain behavior and when customers must update
Step-by-step migration checklist and CLI usage
Rollout schedule and how to opt into staged cutover
comms_templates: Email template: pilot invitation to selected customers
Console banner copy for in-product notices
Webinar slide deck outline and Q&A cheatsheet
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Gateway introduces 5-10ms p95 latency increase -> Mitigation: add shortcut path for cached prefixes and tighten batching constraints
Risk: Billing mismatch for token accounting across v2/v3 -> Mitigation: dual-write mapping in billing service and reconcile script before cutover
Risk: Edge cases in structured output parsing break customer pipelines -> Mitigation: curated eval set + automated observability alerts + rollback gate
Risk: Customers miss comms and face breaking changes -> Mitigation: multi-channel cadence (email, Console, API usage logs), mandatory deprecation header in responses
metrics: Migration adoption: % of active customers migrated within 30/60/90 days
Error delta: 5xx rate delta pre/post gateway (target < 0.05%)
Latency delta: p95 change for routed requests (target < 10ms)
Support load: # of migration-related tickets per 100 migrating customers
support_plan: Week-of-launch dedicated rotation: 2x SRE on-call + 3x Support agents
CS playbook: triage rubric, known issues tracker, canned replies for top-10 questions
Webinar/office-hours schedule: weekly for first 4 weeks post-cutover
Escalation matrix: PM -> Eng lead -> SRE -> CTO on-call for Sev1s
